facts.business: Integra Engineering India Limited manufactures fabricated and assembled components for rolling stock and metro interior segments, serving OEM customers in the railway sector and export markets.

segments.name: Rolling stock and metro interior components

capacity_or_capex.item: Plant and Equipment (Capital Work in Progress)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Expand its presence in rolling stock and metro projects with various OEMs
Enhance capabilities in system integration and assemblies
Build design and development capabilities inhouse and with partnerships
Improve operational efficiency through automation and digitalization
Maximize utilization of newly added capacities

auditor.name: Devesh Pathak & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Secretarial Audit Report is neither an assurance as to the future viability of the Company nor of the efficacy or effectiveness with which the management has conducted the affairs of the Company.

key_risks: Dependency on Rolling stock market: A sudden drop in demand of public transport
Dependence on OEM customers and project-based demand
Pressure on margins due to competitive pricing
Supply chain disruptions and raw material price fluctuations
facts.related_party_note: The details of all related party transactions are placed periodically before the Audit Committee. All the recommendations made by the Audit Committee were accepted by the Board.
